goals.description: Audit existing widget coverage, determine the requested scope and variant status, inspect close precedents across flavors, and prepare concise source-file context for later goals without modifying the workspace.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Remain read-only with respect to /workspace. From the skill folder, run scripts/audit_widget_coverage.py for the requested kebab-case widget, passing --repo /workspace when needed. Inspect the connector, wrappers, exports, tests, relevant flavor precedents, and the special Vue precedents required for recommendation, chat, or filter-suggestions work. Determine whether this is a missing wrapper, variant widget, or connector/render-state change. Write exactly one JSON file at /sog-control/preload-plan.json with shape {"goals":{"G001":["relative/path/from/workspace"]}}, extending the mapping concisely for later goals with only existing useful text source files. Exclude dependencies, build outputs, caches, generated bundles, and SeaOfGoals control files. Do not create or modify any other file.
goals.name: Explore workspace and plan goal context

goals.description: Implement the audited connector and InstantSearch.js widget changes, including required exports, while preserving existing connector APIs for wrapper-only ports and reusing shared connectors for variants.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Work only on the InstantSearch.js foundation required by the audited scope. For wrapper-only work, leave the connector API unchanged. For a variant, reuse its existing connector, preserve the distinct $$widgetType, and do not create redundant connector APIs. When connector or render state is missing or changed, implement it first. Add or update the JS widget, prefer instantsearch-ui-components where appropriate, and wire connector and widget exports through the standard index and UMD entry points after checking whether UMD exposure is intended.
goals.name: Establish JavaScript foundation

goals.description: Add or update the React hook and widget layers, UI component, exports, and all-widgets test utility entry required by the audited scope.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement the React portion against the established connector contract. Create or update the core hook only when the scope requires one; variants must reuse the existing hook. Put React-rendered markup in src/ui/<Pascal>.tsx whenever no instantsearch-ui-components factory exists, including simple markup. Match adjacent props, escape hatches, test conventions, and $$widgetType without introducing unjustified memoization. Wire the hook and widget through their required public and UMD indexes, respecting intentional UMD exclusions. Always add the widget with minimum required props to the all-widgets switch.
goals.name: Implement React flavor

goals.description: Add or update the Vue widget wrapper and public export using established mixin, slot, compatibility-rendering, and widget-type conventions.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement the Vue wrapper against the established connector contract. Match real Vue precedents: use an SFC for slot-heavy markup or a JavaScript render function with renderCompat when sharing instantsearch-ui-components. Preserve createWidgetMixin, createSuitMixin, scoped-slot, prop, escape-hatch, and $$widgetType conventions. For recommendation, chat, or filter-suggestions features, follow the inspected Hits.js, Highlighter.js, DynamicWidgets.js, and util/vue-compat.js patterns. Export the widget from packages/vue-instantsearch/src/widgets.js; do not duplicate automatic plugin registration.
goals.name: Implement Vue flavor

goals.description: Update common widget and connector behavior suites as required and register real setups in every affected flavor.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Add or update tests according to the actual behavior change. Update tests/common/widgets/<widget>/ for wrapper behavior and tests/common/connectors/<widget>/ only for connector parameters or render-state changes. Register applicable suites in each affected flavor's common widget and connector test entry points. Replace target-flavor unsupported placeholders with real setup code and remove the corresponding skippedTests entries. Keep fixtures and assertions aligned with established neighboring suites and verify the React all-widgets coverage added earlier.
goals.name: Wire shared and flavor tests

goals.description: Expose the widget in an existing suitable example only when it is user-facing and the repository already has an appropriate product context.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: First search existing examples for the feature. If the widget is user-facing, update the closest suitable existing example, including getting-started or query-suggestions examples for recommendation, chat, and query-suggestion features. Touch an examples/*/e-commerce app only when the widget fits its storefront UX or established Playwright coverage. If no example change is warranted, leave examples unchanged.
goals.name: Update relevant examples

goals.description: Run focused checks across affected packages and confirm exports, shared behavior, flavor consistency, widget identity, and intentional compatibility constraints.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Run the narrowest relevant formatting, type, unit, common-suite, and example checks for all changed areas, then broaden only as useful. Re-run the widget coverage audit. Confirm consistent $$widgetType values, correct connector and hook reuse for variants, complete public exports, resolved placeholders and skips, and intended UMD behavior such as chat exclusions. Fix failures caused by this port and report any unrelated pre-existing failures clearly.
goals.name: Validate the complete port
